release_notes:
Release v1.5.1 - 2026-11-27

✨ New Features:
  • feat: --create-html writes a static, self-contained HTML report (escaped values, no JavaScript, Content-Security-Policy, private file); a run without the flag is unchanged

🐛 Bug Fixes:
  • fix: the HTML upload sets no content type, as the other reports do (plan part C rule 7), so S3 makes a browser download it
  • fix: the HTML file is named on the console as the Excel file is, and its accounts table says Read in part for an account with a listing not read, as the run notes do
  • fix: the HTML report removes text-direction and C1 control characters from every value, and its S3 upload carries the content type text/html; charset=utf-8 (other uploads unchanged)

📚 Documentation:
  • docs: the HTML upload sets no content type, as the other reports, five languages [skip release]
  • docs: release runbook R25: the tap-status job says why publish-tap ran or was skipped, and a skipped publish-tap is read there; five languages [skip release]
  • docs: the HTML file has its own Data exported line, and the Read in part column of the HTML accounts table follows the run notes, five languages [skip release]
  • docs: the HTML upload carries the content type text/html; charset=utf-8 and text-direction and control characters are removed from the HTML report, five languages [skip release]
  • docs: HTML report (--create-html) in five languages: usage, contents, escaping, CSP, no JavaScript, privacy note; CLI reference, status row, generated sample and docs claims tests [skip release]
  • docs: archive documentation versions after release v1.5.0 [skip release]

✅ Tests:
  • tests: the HTML upload, like the other reports, sets no content type (plan part C rule 7; no architect ruling to change it) [skip release]
  • tests: a tap-status job of the Package workflow names each condition of publish-tap, its value and the first one that is false; it reads no secret [skip release]
  • tests: the HTML Data exported line may follow the progress line's carriage return, as the Excel line does [skip release]
  • tests: behaviour review: the HTML file is named on the console like the Excel file; an account with a listing not read is read in part in the HTML, as the run note says; the CLI surface differs from v1.5.0 only by the help text, the completion word and one selftest module [skip release]
  • tests: the HTML report in the shared atomic-write and file-mode tests: the old file stays when a write fails, and the file is 0600 like the Excel report whatever the old mode and umask [skip release]
  • tests: the HTML report removes direction and C1 control characters from every value; the HTML upload is sent as text/html, the other uploads unchanged (security review findings 1 and 3) [skip release]
  • tests: --create-html writer and CLI: escaping, no external reference, CSP, determinism, masking parity, sections, logo rules, atomic private file, structure, 10 000-row budget; formats without the flag equal v1.5.0, no extra AWS call, S3 upload, template rules [skip release]
  • tests: the v1.5.0 changelog checks read the released v1.5.0 section; the release moved it out of Unreleased [skip release]

📝 Other Changes:
  • ci: the tap-status job of the Package workflow prints each condition of publish-tap with its value, as log lines and a job summary, and names the first one that does not hold; it reads no secret [skip release]

📊 Summary: 19 commits in this release
